outcome: Reliability and validity of the expanded version of the Posttraumatic Growth Inventory-Japanese version (PTGI-X-J)
cohort: 517 Japanese women who had given birth by caesarean section
finding: The PTGI-X-J-PWV is a valid and reliable tool for measuring postpartum posttraumatic growth among Japanese women who have delivered by cesarean section.
mod_finding: This study focused specifically on Japanese women who delivered by cesarean section, examining the validity and reliability of a tool to measure posttraumatic growth.
